info.description: Coinme Crypto-as-a-Service (CaaS) API. Harvested from provider-published per-endpoint OpenAPI blocks at docs.coinme.com/reference. Modular crypto infrastructure: KYC onboarding, quotes, buy/sell orders, wallets, sends, cash on/off-ramp, payment methods, and webhooks.
